user.title: Yeelight Cube Lite Setup

reconfigure.title: Change the lamp's IP address
reconfigure.description: Enter the lamp's new IP address (shown in the Yeelight app). Home Assistant checks that the lamp answers there before using it.

discovery_confirm.title: Yeelight Cube Lite Discovered
discovery_confirm.description:
A Yeelight Cube Lite was found at **{host}** ({name}).

Do you want to set it up?

matter_confirm.title: Yeelight Cube Lite found via Matter
matter_confirm.description:
A Yeelight Cube Lite in Home Assistant's Matter integration, at **{host}**, is not set up here yet. Add it to control it over your local network too (pixel art, text, effects).

Its LAN Control must be on: in the Yeelight app, open the lamp's settings and turn on LAN Control.

error.cannot_connect: No Yeelight Cube Lite answers at this address. Check that the lamp is on, on the same network as Home Assistant, and that LAN Control is on in the Yeelight app.
error.lan_control_needed: The lamp does not answer on your local network yet. Turn on LAN Control in the Yeelight app (the lamp's settings), then submit again.

abort.not_cube_device: This device is not a Yeelight Cube Lite
abort.reconfigure_successful: The lamp's IP address was changed.

lamp_unreachable.title: {name} is unreachable
lamp_unreachable.description:
{name} ({ip}) has not answered for over 30 minutes. Check that it is plugged in, on the same network as Home Assistant, and that LAN Control is on in the Yeelight app. If its IP address changed, choose **Reconfigure** in its entry's menu (Settings → Devices & services → Yeelight Cube Lite).

This message goes away by itself once the lamp answers again.

udp_blocked.title: {name} uses its slower connection
udp_blocked.description:
Home Assistant has not reached {name} ({ip}) over UDP (port 55444) for over 15 minutes, while the lamp answers over TCP (port 55443): something on the network blocks UDP between them (a firewall, a VLAN rule, a container network). Everything still works, with more delay between changes.

Allow UDP port 55444 between Home Assistant and the lamp. This message goes away by itself once UDP works again.

lan_control_off.title: LAN Control is off on {name}
lan_control_off.description:
{name} ({ip}) reports over Matter that its **LAN Control** is off: Home Assistant cannot control it until it is turned back on. In the Yeelight app, open the lamp's settings and turn **LAN Control** on.

This message goes away by itself once LAN Control is on again.

set_clock_style.name: Set Clock Style
set_clock_style.description: Configure the firmware clock in one call: style, color override, content and time format. Any subset of fields may be provided. Drives the Clock card. By default the lamp switches to Clock mode so the change is visible.

color_mode.description: Firmware color palette preset for compatible effects/styles. "normal" keeps each effect's own colors; the others remap the palette.

activate.name: Activate
activate.description: Switch the lamp to Clock mode so the change shows immediately.

preview_gradient_modes.name: Preview Gradient Modes

set_custom_text.name: Set Custom Text
set_custom_text.description: Set text to display on the cube matrix. Clears any existing pixel art and resets scroll position. While the lamp shows its clock or a native effect, the text is kept for when it shows text again (the clock and its rotation go on); to show it over the clock, call save_state first and restore_state after.

send_fx_effect.name: DEBUG: Send FX Effect (raw)
send_fx_effect.description: LOCAL DEBUG ONLY. Sends a raw private LAN command (default set_fx_effect) to the lamp for reverse-engineering. Either provide params (raw JSON array, sent verbatim) or the structured fields (mode/style_id/apply/mixer/color/ data_bytes). Not a stable API.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: Target lamp entity ID.

params.name: Parameters
params.description: Raw params JSON array (sent verbatim, overrides the structured fields).

color.name: Color
color.description: Raw color integer (single int or list of ints).

data_bytes.name: Data bytes
data_bytes.description: Raw data payload as a byte list, e.g. clock: [date(1/2), tz, 12h(0/1), colon(0=blink/1=steady)].

close_socket.name: Close socket
close_socket.description: Close the fast socket before sending (recommended for fx commands).

persist.name: Persist
persist.description: If true and this is the native clock effect (mode 40) with a known style_id (1-14), also update the light's stored clock style so a Force Refresh / state update keeps it instead of reverting.

query_raw.name: DEBUG: Query Raw (capture reply)
query_raw.description: LOCAL DEBUG ONLY. Sends a raw command to the lamp and returns the device's reply. Useful for probing (e.g. get_prop) and observing responses to experimental commands. Not a stable API.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: Target lamp entity ID.

params.name: Parameters

get_capabilities.name: DEBUG: Get Capabilities (SSDP)
get_capabilities.description: LOCAL DEBUG ONLY. Runs the yeelight library's SSDP get_capabilities probe and returns the advertised capability headers (id, model, fw_ver, power, bright, rgb, support, ...). Works regardless of content mode. Not a stable API.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: Target lamp entity ID.

bulb_call.name: DEBUG: Read/Call Bulb Member
bulb_call.description: LOCAL DEBUG ONLY. Reads a read-only member of the yeelight Bulb object (e.g. get_model_specs, bulb_type, capabilities) or invokes an allowlisted write method with positional args (e.g. set_rgb with [255, 0, 0]). Anything outside the allowlists is rejected. Not a stable API.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: Target lamp entity ID.

member.name: Member

args.name: Arguments
args.description: Positional args for write methods, e.g. [255, 0, 0] for set_rgb.

kwargs.name: Keyword arguments
kwargs.description: Optional keyword args for write methods, e.g. light_type 0=Main 1=Ambient.

force_tcp.name: DEBUG: Use TCP
force_tcp.description: LOCAL DEBUG ONLY (administrators). Sends the lamps' commands over TCP (their fallback) for some minutes instead of their UDP session, to test it on demand. 0 minutes: UDP again at once.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: Target lamp entity ID(s).

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: How long (0 to 60 minutes; 0 = UDP again).

set_default.name: DEBUG: Save Current State As Default
set_default.description: LOCAL DEBUG ONLY. Sends the documented set_default command so the lamp restores its CURRENT state after a power cut. Not a stable API.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: Target lamp entity ID (e.g. light.cubelite_192_168_4_102). Must be provided for direct service calls.

start_effect_rotation.name: Start Effect Rotation
start_effect_rotation.description: Start a server-side rotation that advances the lamp through the given effect or clock style names on its own timer. Because the loop runs inside Home Assistant (not the dashboard), it keeps rotating after the browser tab is closed or refreshed. Stop it with stop_effect_rotation; a lamp that is turned off stops its own rotation.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: Target lamp entity ID (e.g. light.cubelite_192_168_4_102). Must be provided for direct service calls.

items.name: Items
items.description: Ordered modes to cycle through. Each item is either a plain name (native effect name, clock style name, or "custom:" followed by a saved preset ID) or an object with name, color_mode and color (an RGB list) that reapplies the color mode recorded with the favourite.

interval.name: Interval
interval.description: Seconds to wait between changes (1 to 604800).

kind.name: Kind
kind.description: Whether the items are native effects or clock styles.

set_favourites.name: Set Favourites
set_favourites.description: Replace a lamp's favourite native effects or clock styles (shown on every dashboard; rotation plays them in this order).

favourites.name: Favourites
favourites.description: Ordered list (at most 100) of objects with name, color_mode and color. Clock presets use "custom:" followed by the preset ID; color is an RGB list for color_mode custom.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: Target lamp entity ID (e.g. light.cubelite_192_168_4_102). Must be provided for direct service calls.

set_rotation_interval.name: Set Rotation Interval
set_rotation_interval.description: Set the rotation interval every dashboard uses for a lamp (per kind). A running rotation of that kind switches to it at once.

kind.name: Kind
kind.description: Which rotation the interval is for.

interval.name: Interval
interval.description: Seconds between changes (1 second to 7 days).

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: Target lamp entity ID (e.g. light.cubelite_192_168_4_102). Must be provided for direct service calls.

stop_effect_rotation.name: Stop Effect Rotation
stop_effect_rotation.description: Stop the server-side effect rotation on the target lamps.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: Target lamp entity ID (e.g. light.cubelite_192_168_4_102). Must be provided for direct service calls.

skip_effect_rotation.name: Skip Effect Rotation
skip_effect_rotation.description: Advance a running server-side effect rotation to its next mode immediately.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: Target lamp entity ID (e.g. light.cubelite_192_168_4_102). Must be provided for direct service calls.

save_state.name: Save State
save_state.description: Snapshot the lamp's current display state (text, colors, gradient mode, angle, drawing/pixel art, font, alignment, orientation, brightness, all color effects and a running effect/clock rotation). Only one snapshot is kept per lamp; calling again overwrites it. Pair with restore_state to show something temporarily and then return to what was displayed before. Note: the snapshot is held in memory and does not survive a Home Assistant restart.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: Target lamp entity ID (e.g. light.cubelite_192_168_4_102). Must be provided for direct service calls.

restore_state.name: Restore State
restore_state.description: Restore the display state previously captured with save_state and re-render it on the lamp. A rotation that was running when it was saved starts again, in step with the lamps still running it. Never turns the lamp on or off. Does nothing if no state was saved.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: Target lamp entity ID (e.g. light.cubelite_192_168_4_102). Must be provided for direct service calls.

set_color_accuracy.name: Set Color Accuracy
set_color_accuracy.description: Toggle hardware color accuracy correction. Applies per-channel gain to compensate for LED color rendering differences vs. a computer monitor. Reduces green and blue channels slightly so yellows, cyans, and whites look neutral rather than greenish, and blues/purples appear deeper instead of washed out. The preview card is NOT affected.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Enable or disable color accuracy correction.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: Target lamp entity ID (e.g. light.cubelite_192_168_4_102). Must be provided for direct service calls.

set_calibration_lock.name: Set Calibration Lock (Internal)
set_calibration_lock.description: Take or release exclusive control of the lamp for the calibration wizard. While locked, the lamp ignores display, brightness, and turn on/off commands coming from automations or other cards, so the wizard's test patterns are not disturbed mid-session. The lock auto-releases after 15 minutes of inactivity as a safety net. Used internally by the calibration card.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Enable (take control) or disable (release control) the lock.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: Target lamp entity ID (e.g. light.cubelite_192_168_4_102).

set_color_calibration.name: Set Color Calibration (Debug)
set_color_calibration.description: Adjust color correction and accuracy calibration values at runtime. All fields are optional — only provided values are updated. Changes are NOT persisted across restarts (set new defaults in code).

gamma_r.name: Gamma (red)
gamma_r.description: System 1 — Red inverse gamma (0.1–1.0, lower = more boost). Default: 0.85

hw_threshold.name: Hardware threshold
hw_threshold.description: System 1 — HW brightness % above which gamma correction is OFF. Default: 50

hw_full.name: Hardware full scale
hw_full.description: System 1 — HW brightness % at/below which gamma correction is 100%. Default: 10

gain_r.name: Gain (red)
gain_r.description: System 2 — Red channel gain multiplier (0.5–1.5). Default: 1.00

gain_g.name: Gain (green)
gain_g.description: System 2 — Green channel gain multiplier. Default: 1.00

gain_b.name: Gain (blue)
gain_b.description: System 2 — Blue channel gain multiplier. Default: 1.00

channel_balance.name: Channel balance
channel_balance.description: System 1 — Blend between uniform (0=hue-safe) and per-channel (1=blue fix) correction. Default: 0.7

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: Target lamp entity ID (e.g. light.cubelite_192_168_4_102). Must be provided for direct service calls.
